doing an entire project in one sitting in a new environment is something I will have to do again and I hope it will be as awesome as using cad. at first the amount of layers lines and shortcuts were annoying but after adapting towards the end, my workflow improved significantly and allowed me to enjoy it somewhat. A lot of things that went wrong were solved by just carefully redoing it or changing the approach completely like with the tabs shapes. I also started my session with a fairly useless declaration of a tone of variables because I saw it being done in the guides I was basing off which took a lot of time and saved around zero. After that the workflow was the same plane-> sketch -> extrude. Overall I'd say that if I had more time I'd do something bigger but the stand is also not bad
